_about: Country facts checked by hand where the two sources differ (task 156). build-facts.mjs applies each entry: `set` replaces the fact, and the fact counts as checked (live in profiles) only while the sources still show the same disagreement (`whenDiffer`) — if a source changes, the entry no longer applies and the fact goes back to 'to check'.
